'''TheOtherMaestro The Incomprable Cloud City Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TheOtherMaestro]]
* '''Published:''' 9 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: West Gallery|SE-D-cloudcitywestgallery.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: West Gallery
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat Cloud City West Gallery TheOtherMa.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Preliminary Note : Do not ever use this deck. This deck is just a joke. I felt like making a deck that was all one planet, so I could have a huge all-out shootout in the city of the clouds. But DO NOT EVER USE IT!!

This deck is all Cloud City sites.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

As you can see, my young apprentice, this whole deck is centered around Dark Deal. Get out as many Characters (especially the Aqualishes) and starships so that you can control Cloud City. With the three Aqualishes, you change the number of sites necessary for the opponents to occupy from 4 to 7!!! (notice also that there are only 6 Cloud City LOCATIONS in this deck)

Once you start getting out those Star Destroyers, put Fear Will Keep them In Line, giving you an added 1 power per starship with that effect on it. (Notice that the effect is not unique)So put that on Executor and Vengeance to give you +2 power, and added with Dark Deal, so now your characters on Cloud City sites have power +6!!!! Think of It. Vader with Power 12!!! Same with Snoova!

Put Gamorrean Ax on Ghana and He has power 12! It should be becoming obvious now, that this deck is designed for brute force.

Put Ket Maliss on Emperor Palpatine and give him Dark Jedi Lightsaber for free. He can't move to an opponent, so put him in a strategic place like Upper Plaza Corridor where them rebels have to go through to keep going on. So station him there, wait for them rebs to come, and hack them to pieces!

Put Turr Phenir, DS-181-3+4 in their respective ships, and get those laser cannons on them, and presto! You have an unbeatable squadron of TIE Interceptors.

It is plain that this deck is not designed for subtlety. It is designed for you to battle your opponents until you make them forfeit all of their characters, and them bleed them white with force drains!!!! Dead Darth Would be proud!

Have fun, win tournaments, and DONT USE THIS DECK!!!
